description: Before relying on another agent: pass the A2A Agent Card you fetched (and the https URL you fetched it from). Finds the Countersign extension in capabilities.extensions, reads that agent's live track record and reports accept, the live numbers, whether the card's snapshot overstates them, and binding (domain_bound when the card's host is on the record owner's proved domain; unbound or mismatch otherwise). The live record decides, never the card. To publish your own: GET /v1/agents/<agent>/card-extension.

card.description: the Agent Card JSON (or the bare extension object)

name: verify_agent_card
title: Verify an agent's A2A Agent Card track record (ce-1)
